_readme: Examples only the website plays, in the same shape as App/Resources/Demo/demo.json (which the apps share and the site never edits). build.py merges these scenarios after reading demo.json; DEMO_TABS and FAMILY_TABS pick which ones the pages show and which agent answers. « agents » and « cards » add an agent and a vote card of the site's own the same way.
